attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kentucky corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.ky_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.ky_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ky_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.ky_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.ky_tax_liability xdef "Kentucky filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KY requires addback of federal interest income and IRC 199A deduction, with subtraction of KY municipal bond interest and dividends from KY corporations.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ky_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ky_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.ky_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ky_state_subtractions xdef "Kentucky adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky corporate income tax. Applies Kentucky flat rate (4.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ky_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ky_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ky_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky corporate tax (flat rate 4.5%); Apply Kentucky 4.5% flat rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.ky_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ky_tax_liability xdef result.ky_estimated_payments result.ky_refund_or_owed xdef "Kentucky tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.ky_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ky_tax_liability xdef result.ky_estimated_payments result.ky_refund_or_owed xdef "Kentucky tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
